# FG-CI-0003

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `cancelling_a_finished_pipeline_is_a_state_conflict` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このパイプラインやジョブは今の状態では取り消し・再実行・実行ができません。画面を読み込み直してください。
- en: This pipeline or job cannot be cancelled, retried or started in its current state. Reload the page.
- id: Pipeline atau tugas ini tidak dapat dibatalkan, dijalankan ulang, atau dimulai dalam keadaannya saat ini. Muat ulang halaman.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C2: `POST …/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/cancel` on a pipeline that is already finished (succeeded, failed, canceled, skipped, invalid, error), or `POST …/retry` on one that is not `failed` or `canceled` (running ones are cancelled first; `invalid` / `error` have no jobs to retry — push a fix or run a new pipeline). M4 C12: `POST …/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/jobs/{job_id}/play` (`operation=play`) on a job that is not waiting for a person (`reason=not_manual`: started already, or no `when: manual` job), in a pipeline that was cancelled or has no jobs (`reason=pipeline_state`: canceled, invalid, error), or before every job it `needs` succeeded (`reason=needs_not_succeeded`). Plan 18 S5: `POST …/merge-requests/{iid}/pipeline` (`operation=run_merge_request`, running the merge request pipeline on the current target) on a merge request that is closed or merged (`reason=not_open`), has nothing pushed yet (`reason=no_version`) or conflicts with its target (`reason=conflict`: no merge result exists, so no pipeline can run on it). The state is read under the rows' locks, so two people pressing at once get one change and one conflict. Not a fault.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `pipeline_id`, `project_id`, `operation` (`cancel` / `retry` / `play` / `run_merge_request`), `status` (the state found) and, for `play`, `job_id` and `reason`; for `run_merge_request`, `project_id`, `iid` and `reason` (`not_open` / `no_version` / `conflict`).

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing to fix: reload the pipeline. To run again a pipeline that cannot be retried, start a new one (gstn pipeline run --project <id> --ref <branch>). For `needs_not_succeeded`, wait for (or retry) the jobs it needs, then start it again. For `run_merge_request`: a closed merge request needs none; push a version first (`no_version`); resolve the conflict and push (`conflict`) — the new head's merge result gets its pipeline by itself.
